description: Solve for the minimum hourly rate a freelancer must charge to hit a target annual take-home income, given billable hours per week, weeks actually worked per year, annual business overhead, and an optional profit margin/buffer applied on top.

annualOverheadCosts.description: Annual business expenses (software, insurance, etc.), default 0

profitMarginPercent.description: Extra buffer/profit margin percent applied on top of income plus overhead, default 0

weeksPerYear.description: Weeks actually worked per year, after vacation/holidays

name: calculate_freelancer_rate
